ne527ecab78.headline: 3 years on, here's what to keep an eye on in the Ukraine war — and efforts to end it
ne527ecab78.summary: Thousands of civilians have been killed since Russia's full-scale invasion began on February 24, 2022. Ukrainians want the war to end, but not on Russia's terms.
ne527ecab78.why: The war affects European energy, grain and defence spending, and the outcome shapes sanctions and reconstruction financing.

n2ff26a73c5.headline: Apple will move manufacturing from Mexico to the US, Trump claims
n2ff26a73c5.summary: Donald Trump said Apple's CEO promised to move manufacturing currently in Mexico to plants in the United States. No further details were given in the input.
n2ff26a73c5.why: Apple is one of the world's largest consumer electronics companies, and its supply chain decisions affect manufacturing, trade flows and tariff exposure.

nef9d395c1c.headline: Oil exports could start within days as Iraq awaits Türkiye
nef9d395c1c.summary: Iraq is waiting for Türkiye's approval to restart oil flows from the Kurdistan Regional Government in northern Iraq, the Iraqi Oil Minister said. Exports could start within days.
nef9d395c1c.why: Kurdistan's crude flows through Turkish territory to global markets, so restarting them affects regional crude supply.

nb5f5f423c8.headline: Euro nudges up briefly as conservatives in Germany win elections
nb5f5f423c8.summary: The euro posted early gains on Monday after Germany's opposition conservatives secured the national election, as expected, while the dollar was little changed.
nb5f5f423c8.why: Germany is the euro zone's largest economy, so its government formation shapes fiscal policy and sentiment for the single currency.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Political outcome in Germany lifted the euro against the dollar in early trade.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n2b9c89f1b5.headline: Greenpeace faces a $300 million lawsuit after Dakota Access Pipeline protests
n2b9c89f1b5.summary: The company behind the Dakota Access Pipeline is suing Greenpeace for at least $300 million in damages over protests in 2016 and 2017 that it says caused losses.
n2b9c89f1b5.why: Large damages claims against activist groups test how far companies can recover losses from protests that disrupt energy infrastructure projects.

n7d4c29dd76.headline: State Revenue Service reports tax debts on a rise in Latvia
n7d4c29dd76.summary: Latvia's State Revenue Service reports total tax debt, including current, suspended debts and repayment extensions, stood at EUR 850.606 million at the start of February 2025. The debt level is rising.
n7d4c29dd76.why: Tax arrears are an indicator of business cash-flow stress and fiscal collection health in the Baltic economy.

n5be5dfef47.headline: Moody's downgrades Senegal after audit PM dubs 'catastrophic'
n5be5dfef47.summary: Moody's has downgraded Senegal's credit rating following an audit that the prime minister described as catastrophic. The headline reports the downgrade and the government's reaction.
n5be5dfef47.why: Moody's is a major credit rating agency, and sovereign downgrades raise borrowing costs for governments and affect investor appetite for their debt.

n117595fb6d.headline: Will Germany’s new government restore its role as a leader of the EU?
n117595fb6d.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz can rebuild European relationships and drive defence spending, but faces the effects of Trump's upending of postwar certainties.
n117595fb6d.why: Germany is the EU's largest economy, so its fiscal and defence choices shape European growth and industrial demand.

n5fd938df5e.headline: Ukraine’s rare earth mineral wealth barely exists
n5fd938df5e.summary: Control of Ukraine's mineral wealth has become a new front in the conflict, with Donald Trump recently announcing he wanted access. The report says the supposedly vast resources barely exist.
n5fd938df5e.why: Rare earths are critical inputs for electronics, defence and clean-energy equipment, so access to supply shapes strategic and industrial decisions.

n78a8c0112e.headline: The exact date you should turn your heating off as energy bills set to rise
n78a8c0112e.summary: Energy bills are set to rise again in April, with the latest forecast suggesting a 5% increase for typical household energy bills. The report did not specify the underlying cause.
n78a8c0112e.why: Household energy prices feed into UK inflation and consumer spending, which influence Bank of England policy and retail demand.

n4dfc047335.headline: German election: the results explained as Friedrich Merz comes out swinging for Europe – The Moderate Voice
n4dfc047335.summary: Friedrich Merz is set to become chancellor after the CDU/CSU won the February 23 election with 28.5%. He will seek a coalition with the SPD, which fell to a record low of 16.4%.
n4dfc047335.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, so its government's fiscal and defence policies affect European growth, bond markets and the euro.

n1e9b5e6cf0.headline: Germany Debt Brake Reform Plans
n1e9b5e6cf0.summary: Friedrich Merz is exploring using the outgoing parliament to loosen Germany's debt brake, amid opposition from the AfD and Die Linke. The move creates a political and economic challenge.
n1e9b5e6cf0.why: The debt brake limits German federal borrowing, so changing it affects government bond supply and fiscal capacity in the euro area's largest economy.

neaa363321f.headline: Retail inflation eases slightly to 4.61% for farm workers, 4.73% for rural labourers - OrissaPOST
neaa363321f.summary: Retail inflation for farm workers eased to 4.61% and for rural labourers to 4.73% in January, from 5.01% and 5.05% in December 2024, government data showed.
neaa363321f.why: Consumer price inflation for rural households shapes India's policy outlook, including central bank interest rate decisions, and affects rural demand.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

nc95823e5ed.headline: Steve Reed to reveal 50% public procurement targets for food
nc95823e5ed.summary: Defra secretary Steve Reed is due to reveal targets that at least 50% of food supplied to the public sector is homegrown or meets British standards.
nc95823e5ed.why: Public sector food contracts are a large source of demand for UK farmers and food suppliers, so procurement targets shape their market.

n0001d981c6.headline: Eurozone CPI finalized at 2.5% in Jan, core CPI holds at 2.7%
n0001d981c6.summary: Eurozone headline inflation was finalized at 2.5% year on year in January, up from 2.4% in December, while core CPI held at 2.7%.
n0001d981c6.why: Eurozone inflation data guides the European Central Bank's interest rate decisions, which affect the euro and European bond yields.

n40cf02b41f.headline: Westlake Chemical Partners:  Q4 Earnings Snapshot
n40cf02b41f.summary: Westlake Chemical Partners reported fourth-quarter earnings of $15 million, or 43 cents per share, according to MarketScreener. The Houston-based company's results were released on Monday.
n40cf02b41f.why: Westlake Chemical Partners is a Houston-based limited partnership that holds petrochemical assets linked to its parent, Westlake Corporation. Its results reflect demand and margins in the chemicals sector.

neea86e6268.headline: British PM says G7 should be ready to take on more risk
neea86e6268.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer said on Monday that G7 countries should be willing to take on more risk over sanctions against Russia over its invasion of Ukraine.
neea86e6268.why: The G7 is a group of major advanced economies that coordinates financial sanctions and economic policy, which affect global energy and commodity markets.

n4768eb587b.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Stocks Poised to Recover Ground
n4768eb587b.summary: Stock futures were higher on Monday, with investor mood improving after the S&P 500 posted its worst session of the year on Friday. The sell-off followed signs of weakness in the US economy.
n4768eb587b.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the most widely followed barometer of US equity performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Futures rose after the index's worst session of the year on signs of US economic weakness.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n4768eb587b.why_moved: The index's worst session of the year on Friday, linked to signs of US economic weakness, was followed by improving investor mood ahead of Monday's trading.

n60e3389954.headline: Ringgit rallies vs US dollar amid easing trade tension
n60e3389954.summary: The ringgit extended gains against the US dollar on Monday. Easing US-China trade tension and weaker US economic data supported the currency.
n60e3389954.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its value affects the cost of imports and the competitiveness of the country's exports. Malaysia is a major exporter of electronics, oil and gas, and palm oil.

nfff3b42ec5.headline: Dutton says Coalition will pay to match Labor’s $8.5bn Medicare boost by cutting thousands of public service jobs
nfff3b42ec5.summary: Opposition leader Peter Dutton said the Coalition would pay for matching Labor's $8.5 billion Medicare boost by cutting public service jobs. He claimed the cuts would save $6 billion a year.
nfff3b42ec5.why: Australia's federal budget and public service workforce size affect fiscal settings, government spending and bond supply.

ncca8c2db59.headline: GPs warn not all practices will take up Labor’s promised Medicare bulk-billing changes if rebates still too low
ncca8c2db59.summary: GPs warned that not all practices will adopt Labor's promised Medicare bulk-billing changes if rebates remain too low. The health minister said modelling shows most practices will benefit.
ncca8c2db59.why: Medicare rebate levels determine general practice revenues and the financial viability of primary care clinics in Australia.

n89fc4f5402.headline: Nvidia's chip demand faces scrutiny as DeepSeek stirs doubts on AI spending
n89fc4f5402.summary: Demand for Nvidia's AI chips is in focus ahead of its Wednesday results, as investors question heavy AI spending after low-cost models emerged.
n89fc4f5402.why: Nvidia designs the graphics processors widely used to train and run AI models, so its results are a key gauge of demand for AI infrastructure.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Investor doubts about AI spending bear directly on expected demand for Nvidia's chips ahead of results.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n89fc4f5402.why_moved: Investors are doubting whether heavy AI spending will continue after low-cost AI models emerged, so expectations for Nvidia's results are under pressure.

nc1ea83223f.headline: Rancher-backed solar power bill loses glimmer with amendments
nc1ea83223f.summary: A Wyoming bill to extend net-metering credits to ranches, churches and municipalities has been amended in a way that solar advocates say is less favourable.
nc1ea83223f.why: Net-metering rules set the credit rate for small solar generators feeding power to the grid, which determines the economics of rooftop and distributed solar.

n9f2e984dbd.headline: Nestle India considering price hikes to counter commodity inflation, executive says
n9f2e984dbd.summary: Nestle India will consider raising product prices by a small margin to counter inflation in coffee, cocoa and edible oil, while aiming to keep sales growing, a top executive said.
n9f2e984dbd.why: Nestle India is the local unit of the Swiss food group Nestle, selling packaged foods, beverages and coffee in India. Its pricing decisions indicate how commodity costs pass through to consumer staples margins.

n5243abfd22.headline: Futures bounce after Wall St selloff; Nvidia results draw near
n5243abfd22.summary: U.S. stock index futures rose on Monday as risk-taking recovered after a sharp Wall Street selloff the previous week. Investors awaited pivotal results from chip giant Nvidia.
n5243abfd22.why: US index futures signal expected opening moves in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq. Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its results are watched as a read on AI demand.

n3bfdfbc672.headline: CBA seeks to reassure customers at 'challenging time'
n3bfdfbc672.summary: Commonwealth Bank chief executive Matt Comyn has sought to reassure customers amid difficult economic conditions. He also addressed the role of physical cash.
n3bfdfbc672.why: The Commonwealth Bank is Australia's largest bank by market value and a major mortgage lender.

n2993399d29.headline: Ryanair to cut routes in Europe as Spain among routes affected
n2993399d29.summary: Ryanair has made changes to its summer schedule and will operate fewer flights in 2025, with Spain among the affected routes. The budget airline is trimming capacity in Europe.
n2993399d29.why: Ryanair is Europe's largest low-cost airline, and its capacity decisions affect airport traffic and fares across the region.

n83a3ea850b.headline: Top German bosses want government formed fast
n83a3ea850b.summary: Top German business leaders want a government formed quickly after an election that shifted the country to the right. Friedrich Merz looks likely to lead a CDU-SPD coalition.
n83a3ea850b.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and coalition stability shapes fiscal, energy and trade policy that matters for investors.

n8722c5ad91.headline: German industry braces itself for trade conflict with the USA
n8722c5ad91.summary: Peter Leibinger, head of the Federation of German Industries, said the future German government faces major challenges from US President Donald Trump's customs policy.
n8722c5ad91.why: Germany's export-heavy industry depends on US demand, so tariffs and trade disputes affect German manufacturers, their earnings and the broader euro-area economy.

ned64fa725c.headline: Trump says tariffs on Mexico, Canada moving forward March 4
ned64fa725c.summary: President Trump said he will proceed with 25% tariffs on most imports from Canada and Mexico starting March 4. The move was announced Monday.
ned64fa725c.why: Canada and Mexico are the largest trading partners of the US, so broad tariffs affect cross-border supply chains, currencies and the earnings of companies that rely on North American trade.
ned64fa725c.why_moved: The announced 25% tariffs on most imports from Canada and Mexico, effective March 4, raise trade costs and uncertainty for cross-border supply chains.

nee09fb065e.headline: Sensex drops below 75,000-mark; Nifty tanks 188 points on weak US markets, relentless FII selling
nee09fb065e.summary: The Sensex slipped below 75,000 and the Nifty fell 188 points, with HCL Tech, IndusInd Bank, Zomato and TCS among the biggest laggards. Weak US markets and relentless foreign institutional investor selling were cited.
nee09fb065e.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are India's main benchmark equity indices, and foreign institutional investor flows are a major driver of their moves.
nee09fb065e.why_moved: The input cites weak US markets and relentless foreign institutional investor selling, with heavy losses in large IT and bank stocks.

n0c66397c5e.headline: Bursa Malaysia slides into red on broad-based selling
n0c66397c5e.summary: Bursa Malaysia fell as 731 stocks declined, reflecting strong selling pressure. The move came as the corporate earnings season entered its final week.
n0c66397c5e.why: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, and its benchmark index tracks the performance of the country's largest listed companies.

n92b38021f4.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street holds steadier but still falls following last week's tumble
n92b38021f4.summary: U.S. stocks drifted lower on Monday to extend sharp losses from last week. The S&P 500 dipped 0.5% after flipping between small gains and losses through the day.
n92b38021f4.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index fell 0.5% on the day, extending losses from the prior week.

n92b38021f4.why_moved: The index dipped 0.5% after trading between small gains and losses, extending sharp losses from the previous week.

n7cd08fb458.headline: Sime Darby's 2Q core net profit rises 13% to RM305mil
n7cd08fb458.summary: Sime Darby's second-quarter core net profit rose 13% to RM305 million. Group CEO Jeffri Salim Davidson cited an increasingly challenging market and lower margins in China due to intense competition.
n7cd08fb458.why: Sime Darby is a Malaysian conglomerate with interests in plantations, motors and property, so its results reflect regional commodity and consumer demand.

n4e227484a3.headline: Pennsylvania Treasurer bans Deepseek AI from Treasury devices
n4e227484a3.summary: Pennsylvania Treasurer Stacy Garrity banned the use of DeepSeek AI on all Treasury-issued devices due to security concerns.
n4e227484a3.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI platform, and government restrictions on such tools reflect growing scrutiny of foreign technology in public systems.

n89481efa39.headline: Toronto Stocks Edge Forward, IA Financial Rises on Rosy Growth Targets
n89481efa39.summary: Toronto stocks were slightly higher, led by a broad push from most sectors. Consumer services, retail and consumer discretionary stocks were the main gainers. IA Financial rose on its growth targets.
n89481efa39.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, so its daily moves reflect broad sentiment in the country's listed companies. IA Financial is a Canadian insurance and wealth management company.

n7188744581.headline: US port charges on China vessels add to supply chain uncertainty
n7188744581.summary: A US plan to promote American maritime interests by penalizing China-linked shipping adds to supply chain uncertainty, according to experts. The experts said it only complicates existing supply chain problems.
n7188744581.why: US port fees on Chinese-built or Chinese-operated vessels can raise shipping costs and reroute trade flows between the two largest economies. These costs typically pass through to importers and consumers.

n21acaecfca.headline: Starmer: Trump Has Changed the Conversation on Ukraine
n21acaecfca.summary: Europe plans to present its own peace initiative for Ukraine, amid ongoing conflict and geopolitical tensions.
n21acaecfca.why: A peace plan could influence geopolitical stability and defense spending in Europe.

n04ffc3a0ac.headline: S. Korea to fully resume short selling as planned: chief regulator
n04ffc3a0ac.summary: South Korea's financial regulator confirmed the planned lifting of the temporary ban on short selling next month.
n04ffc3a0ac.why: Short selling rules affect market liquidity and investor strategies in South Korea's equity markets.
n04ffc3a0ac.why_moved: The regulator's confirmation affects market expectations about liquidity and risk in South Korean equities.

n92c3b2fd5b.headline: Okonjo-Iweala’s timely warning on foreign aid
n92c3b2fd5b.summary: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala warned African leaders to stop relying on foreign aid and focus on mobilizing domestic resources amid rising external debt.
n92c3b2fd5b.why: Africa’s rising external debt poses risks to economic stability; mobilizing domestic resources is critical for sustainable growth and investment.

nd45f140c59.headline: Updated BYD Atto 3 with God’s Eye C reached dealers in China
nd45f140c59.summary: BYD launched the updated Atto 3 electric crossover equipped with the God’s Eye C driving assistance system at dealerships across China.
nd45f140c59.why: BYD is a leading Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer, and new model launches with advanced tech influence the EV market and consumer adoption.

n9f4480c316.headline: NIPCO partners suppliers to lower CNG conversion kit prices
n9f4480c316.summary: NIPCO Gas Nigeria Limited announced plans to make Compressed Natural Gas conversion kits more affordable and efficient through supplier partnerships.
n9f4480c316.why: Lowering conversion kit prices could boost adoption of cleaner fuel alternatives, impacting energy consumption and related industries in Nigeria.

nc47ea08b1d.headline: TP bolsters sustainable operations, 60% energy use sourced from RE
nc47ea08b1d.summary: Teleperformance in the Philippines committed to sustainable operations by sourcing 60% of its energy use from renewable sources, aligning with UN Sustainable Development Goals.
nc47ea08b1d.why: Sustainability initiatives by major companies reflect growing corporate responsibility trends and can influence operational costs and investor appeal.

nad9836c8f5.headline: Affair of the 91 billion credit: The zones d
nad9836c8f5.summary: Senegal's Court of Audit report says the finance minister signed a 91 billion credit in January 2022 on behalf of the state, under a secret classification.
nad9836c8f5.why: Undisclosed public borrowing affects Senegal's debt transparency, which investors and lenders monitor closely.

nc414d57e98.summary: Starting Monday, Serasa and Correios will offer free nationwide service for indebted people, who can check discounted debts at any Correios branch.
nc414d57e98.why: Serasa is a major Brazilian credit bureau, and debt negotiation programmes affect household credit recovery and bad-debt collection.

nde206940bc.summary: A new debt rescheduling program for customers of the Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas (STEG) and the water utility SONEDE has started. The program is aimed at households and businesses owing arrears.
nde206940bc.why: STEG and SONEDE are Tunisia's state utilities for power, gas and water, and their finances affect public debt and fiscal policy.

n6526ce2cfb.summary: A memorandum to stabilise prices of socially important food products has been signed in Kazakhstan, with egg imports set to be banned again, El.kz reported.
n6526ce2cfb.why: Import restrictions on staple foods change domestic supply and consumer price inflation in the affected country.

n3e928bb1c1.why: STEG and SONEDE are the state utilities supplying Tunisia's electricity and water, and their receivables affect their finances.

nb901060673.headline: Focus Bulletin: Market Economists Raise Inflation Estimate for 2025 and 2026
nb901060673.summary: Market economists raised their inflation estimates for 2025 and 2026, according to the Central Bank's Focus survey. They kept their 2025 GDP growth projection at 2.01%.
nb901060673.why: The Focus survey aggregates analyst forecasts for inflation, interest rates and growth, and shapes expectations for Brazil's central bank policy.
